entries.title: Release update
entries.summary: This is the best and most reliable state the extension has reached so far. Download buttons, flag placement, and post detection are now much more accurate in real Google Classroom usage.

Stronger protection against bad detections and unstable page structures.
Download buttons are now much more careful about where they appear.
